[[File:SoullessOne-TCW.png|thumb|right|300px|The hull of ''Soulless One'' was coated in impervium.]]
'''Impervium''' was an almost impenetrable alloy known to have been used to coat the hulls of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==History==
It was notably used on the hull of [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']]&mdash;the personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Although impervium could be penetrated by an ''en masse'' barrage of concentrated [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire, Grievous was never faced with such a show of force while piloting ''Soulless One'', as he was usually aboard his flagship, the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], during most battles and engagements. Because of its impervium coating, the fighter made an effective shuttle for the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general, since it could not be easily destroyed.

[[Lig sword]]s were also made from impervium.

Impervium was later used in the [[molecular furnace]]s of the [[World Devastator]]s constructed by the resurgent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the reborn [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
